metricHelp.kvCache: Free tokens left in the engine’s KV-cache pool, over the allocated pool (tokens and memory). The pool is shared across concurrent requests and can be larger than one request’s max context. High usage (≥80% full) means little room for new or long contexts and often leads to queuing or preemptions.
metricHelp.requests: Run = requests actively generating on the GPU. Wait = accepted but not yet scheduled (capacity or constraints). Growing wait with high KV cache usually means the server is overloaded.
metricHelp.ttftMean: Mean time-to-first-token reported by FreeToken (a mean, not a percentile): how long requests wait until the first output token.
metricHelp.ttftP95: 95th percentile time-to-first-token from the engine’s request history: how long “slow” requests wait until the first output token. Spikes mean queueing, long prefills, or cold paths—not average decode speed.
metricHelp.preempts: Cumulative times the engine paused a running request to free KV cache for others. Rising under load signals memory pressure; zero is normal when the server is comfortable.
metricHelp.prefixCache: Lifetime fraction of prefix-cache lookups that hit (hits ÷ queries). Higher means more prompt reuse and less prefill work; — when the series is missing or unused.
metricHelp.e2eP95: 95th percentile end-to-end request latency from the engine’s request history: arrival until the request finishes. Includes queue wait, prefill, and decode—not just token generation speed.
metricHelp.itlP95: 95th percentile inter-token latency (time between successive output tokens) from the engine’s request history. Spikes mean decode stalls or contention; lower is smoother streaming.
metricHelp.mtpAccept: Lifetime speculative / MTP acceptance rate (accepted draft tokens ÷ drafted tokens). Higher means speculative decoding is paying off; — when speculation is off or unused.

settings.title: LLM settings

engine.title: Engine
engine.help: Active = processing or ready for requests. Sleeping = idle, GPU memory freed until next request.
engine.unreportedHelp: This backend does not report engine sleep state

llm.title: LLM server
llm.sshHelp: This engine's port is not reachable from the dashboard, so it is read through an SSH tunnel to the unit
llm.perStreamHelp: Average decode throughput of one running stream (1 / mean seconds per output token). Only engines that publish a per-token latency histogram report it.
llm.notMeasuredHelp: The endpoint answered, but no rate could be measured on the last poll.
llm.perRequestHelp: Effective prefill rate of one request: prompt tokens ÷ prefill seconds over the finished window. The prompt counter includes prefix-cache tokens (this surface has no cached counter), so it is an effective speed, not raw GPU speed. The engine publishes prefill seconds only when a request finishes, so it is held between completions.
llm.cachedPrefillHelp: Prefill tokens served from prefix cache (little GPU work). High values mean prompt reuse, not a faster cold prefill.
llm.uncachedPrefillHelp: Uncached (computed) prefill — tokens that actually build KV cache on the GPU.
llm.localHint: Runs against this Spark’s LLM. Remote units use LAN HTTP, or an SSH tunnel to loopback if the server only listens on 127.0.0.1.
llm.qualityHelp: Quality suite (QA, reasoning, arithmetic, state tracking, GSM8K, MMLU) against this port's model. Compare runs across models, quantizations and KV-cache formats.
llm.strataDecodeHelp: Live sliding-window decode rate. When that window is unavailable, the active-slot mean sums each active slot’s generated tokens divided by its elapsed time since first token; it excludes prefill time.
llm.strataPrefillHelp: Engine-reported mean for computed/new prompt tokens. It may be from an earlier prefill and is not an aggregate across slots.
llm.tensorfoldPrefillHelp: Prompt tokens computed per second of prefill time (the engine's prefill-time and cached-token counters, finished requests only), held between completions. Tokens restored from the prompt cache are not counted here; they are the Cached prefill rate.
llm.prefillHelp: Prompt tokens/sec taken in during the last poll window — cache-served + computed. Opening a saved chat in the UI does not hit the GPU; send (or regenerate) so the history is sent as the prompt. Cached prefill does little GPU work; uncached prefill is what builds KV cache.
llm.strataPrefillingHelp: A prompt is being processed; no current prefill rate is available.
llm.prefillingHelp: A prompt is being processed. The engine reports its speed only when the request finishes.
llm.decodeHelp: Decode benchmark: generation speed at rising concurrency, on this Spark. {{hint}}
llm.prefillBenchHelp: Prefill benchmark: prompt processing speed and time to first token, on this Spark. {{hint}}
llm.perRequest: {{rate}} tok/s per request — effective (incl. cached tokens)
llm.engineGeneratedHelp: Reported by the engine since it last started
